assets.prompt: Transparent handwritten Chinese glyph atlas, exact five-column two-row regular grid. Row 1: 今 天 ， 你 听. Row 2: 见 了 什 么 ？. Each symbol isolated with generous transparent padding. Match approved black dry charcoal/pencil lettering, subtly curved organic brush strokes, playful irregular proportions and visible texture. No grid lines, labels, background, shadow or decorations.

Transparent hand-drawn doodle atlas, exact three-column two-row grid. Row 1: eighth note, paired eighth notes, quarter note. Row 2: imperfect round bubble, loose oval bubble with a small natural gap, lopsided bubble with pencil overlap. Thin soft black freehand pencil texture, irregular contours and pressure, no geometric circles, no polished icons, no background, labels, scene or title.

processing: Deterministic cell extraction, alpha-bound trim and packed WebP/PNG sprites. Only simple bubble contours are sampled into native SVG; no embedded raster in SVG. Glyph arch/proportions and entrance timings live in config/title.ts. No runtime pixel processing or glyph masks.
latestDecision: Follow approved sketch size proportions. Pop in characters in sequence, then keep text still. Only decorations rise and fade in loops, behind letters and under foliage.
